notes: ACCESS: tier (a) curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome120) worked for robots.txt and every category-page HTML fetch (all 200 OK). Homepage/global mega-menu required tier (b) escalation: headless Playwright was Akamai-blocked (403 Access Denied on / even after JS wait), so per rule I retried headed Chromium with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled, which rendered the full mega-menu successfully (385KB DOM, 323 links) - used only for nav discovery, not for data/qty. TREE: union of the rendered mega-menu (all top-level tabs: New, Furniture, Outdoor, Mirrors & Art, Decor & More, Rugs & Drapery, Lighting, Bed & Bath, Fabric, Dorm, Holiday & Gifts, Sale) plus each category page's own breadcrumb/canonical to confirm node identity. No sitemap.xml/sitemap_index.xml exists (404->error page), so mega-menu union was the primary tree source. QTY: every category page is a WCS(IBM Commerce)+Unbxd storefront; the SSR HTML embeds a recommendationCategoryID which is also the Unbxd category id, and the site's own internal endpoint https://www.ballarddesigns.com/UnbxdAPI?categoryId=<id>&rows=36&banner=true&returnRespAsJSON=true&isAPI=true&requesttype=ajax (same-origin, discovered via one Playwright network-request capture, then called directly over curl_cffi for every other node - tier a) returns exact {categoryName, numberOfProducts}; qty = numberOfProducts, evidence cites this. Confirmed node identity via <link rel=canonical> + JSON-LD breadcrumb on each page against the requested slug. DEDUPE: 3 nodes were reachable via two nav paths pointing to the SAME categoryId/product set (Outdoor Drapery: /rugs-drapery/drapery/outdoor/ vs canonical /outdoor/rugs-drapery/drapery/; Outdoor Throw Pillows: /decor-more/pillows/outdoor-pillows/ vs canonical /outdoor/cushions-pillows/pillows/; Outdoor Fabric: /outdoor/fbty/ vs canonical /fabric/indoor-outdoor-fabric/) - kept one record each at the canonical URL, dropped the alias. EXCLUDED (checked, not included): Drapery Hardware / Drapery Hardware Collections (curtain hardware, explicit textile.md exclusion); Rug Pads & Grippers (underlayment/padding accessory, not a decorative textile product); The Queens Velvet Collection (named/branded 'Collection' page, excluded per View-All/Collections rule); Bathroom Accessories/bath 'accessories' bucket (sample-checked: mirrors, hooks, tissue-box covers, jewelry holders - decorative bath hardware, not primarily textile or storage); Outdoor Furniture Care (sample-checked: fabric cleaners/protectors and teak cleaners - cleaning products, neither category); Mattresses & Foundations (furniture, not textile); Kitchen & Tabletop Accessories under Decor & More (sample-checked: salt/pepper sets, candle holders, coasters - Kitchen & Dining/Decorative territory). STORAGE-SPECIFIC EXCLUSIONS: sample-checked every 'Organization'/'Storage' named node's actual product mix. /furniture/home-organization/* (Closet Storage & Systems, Bathroom Storage & Seating, Laundry Organization) and /bed-bath/bed-bath-organization/* (Bathroom Storage & Seating, Laundry Racks & Storage, Closet Systems & Storage) are dominated by literal furniture (armoires, dressers, cabinets, benches, stools, luggage racks - many identical SKUs cross-listed in both branches) despite the 'storage/organization' category naming; per the Core Classification Principle (PRIMARY PRODUCT TYPE over website hierarchy) these were excluded from Storage as furniture, consistent with Furniture.xlsx territory. /furniture/entry/entryway-storage-seating/ excluded for the same reason (benches/ottomans/cabinets dominate). /furniture/dining-kitchen/bar-carts-storage/ (site categoryName 'Bar Carts & Cabinets') excluded as furniture. By contrast /decor-more/organization/* (Wall Organization, Office Accessories, Baskets) sits outside the Furniture nav branch and is genuinely accessory/organizer-scale (hooks, small wall cabinets, baskets, hampers, waste bins, desk organizers) - included, with Office Accessories flagged LOW (sample-checked: majority items were decorative desk accessories - pin boards, tortoise stand, book easel - with only a minority being true organizers) and Wall Organization flagged MEDIUM (mostly hooks/brackets/small wall cabinets). /outdoor/storage/ ('Storage Solutions': storage cabinets, storage cube, storage bin, storage side table) included HIGH. TEXTILE LOW-CONFIDENCE: Stockings & Holders (/holiday/stockings/, qty 9) sample-checked as a genuinely mixed listing (fabric stockings + stocking holders/stands/hooks which are hardware) under one URL with no way to split - included at LOW confidence, flagged. Fireplace & Hearth, Vases, Candles, Hooks/Cabinet Knobs & Pulls, Wall Shelves (Decor & More and Dorm variants), Luggage Racks - checked against both rule files and excluded as neither Textile nor Storage (decorative accessories / hardware / wall decor / furniture-adjacent, not primary-purpose textile or storage).
